raw_response:
1. The figure does not show any benchmark lines or explicit performance thresholds for MBPP (or other datasets), so it’s not possible to judge threshold attainment; it only shows that “Ours” is roughly equal to LLaMA-3-8B-it on MBPP and varies across datasets.
